Then I shall charge onward! To do battle with destiny! No, wait, but my master did say that to wish for too much at once is the same as losing it all. Does that mean I must stay true to only one!? So does that mean that, to turn their plan against them, I must protect my love for both of them and my loyalty to the Princess, all at once? No, but then I would defy my master's teaching.
